title: SKILLS -- reusable procedures an agent loads by their description (the Agent Skills unit)
description: A skill is the Agent Skills unit (agentskills.io): a NAME and a DESCRIPTION loaded on every turn, a BODY loaded only when the skill is activated, and supporting FILES read or run only when the body says so. Declared once here; the front matter every product parses is a projection of this row, so the body file carries prose only. Every path is relative to this document and may not leave its directory; a skill's files lie inside the directory of its body. Deterministic steps belong in `files` as scripts the body tells the agent to RUN -- prose is for what needs judgement (ADR-024, every token serves the result).

id.description: The skill's name: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, neither first nor last (the Agent Skills name rule); it is also the directory a product reads it from.

description.description: What the skill does AND when to use it, in the words a model decides on: loaded on every turn, so it is the skill's whole cost until activated. 1-1024 characters (the Agent Skills limit).

body.description: The Markdown body, relative to this document, with no front matter.

files.description: Supporting files (scripts/, references/, assets/), relative to this document, inside the body's directory, served beside SKILL.md verbatim.

allowed_tools.description: Tools pre-approved while the skill runs, in the product's own spelling (the Agent Skills `allowed-tools`, experimental).

task_class.description: The class of work the skill carries out, from the declared task-class vocabulary (ADR-024).
